closely_coupled_standard_capacitor_land_.scope_limit: No other ordinary passive values or lands are changed without a demonstrated part-specific issue.

system_analysis_limits.input_capacitor_guidance: 10 uF is sufficient for most applications, not a guaranteed biased minimum for every case.
system_analysis_limits.feedforward_guidance: Recommended above 40 uF output capacitance; include other connected output capacitors and actual operating conditions.
system_analysis_limits.inductor_screen: At 2.8 V to 5 V, 0.7 uH tolerance-only minimum and 1 MHz typical frequency: 1.76 App ripple; 2 A mean gives 2.88 A peak, about 2.064 A RMS and 83 mW cold winding loss using 19.5 milliohm. Excludes AC/core loss, current-dependent inductance, hot DCR, minimum-frequency/startup/fault behavior.
system_analysis_limits.output_ripple_screen: 0.75 A, ideal duty 0.44, 1 MHz and two typical 9.964 uF output capacitors gives about 16.6 mVpp capacitive ripple; excludes ESR/ESL/interconnect/control/transients.
system_analysis_limits.bead_loss_screen: At ideal 3 W/4 ohm current 0.866 A RMS, the selected pair's maximum initial cold DCR gives about 37.5 mW. This is not a claim of actual 3 W audio capability.
unclosed: Full native routing and current budgets
